rows.label: tlk70000068_04_msg0001
rows.name:
So this is what Iira really looked
like? It was sealed away all this
time? Seriously...?

rows.label: tlk70000068_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I liked the sparkly ball that
was at the top of the royal
palace, but it's gone now.

rows.label: tlk70000068_04_msg0003
rows.name:
There's so much I don't know!
About my dad's job, about Iira...

rows.label: tlk70000068_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Would it change anything if I did
know more? I wonder if there's
really much a guy like me can do...

rows.label: tlk70000068_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I don't really understand it, but I
want to change. I want to do something
for Iira and everyone here!
